column1: # THE FULL CELL CENSUS — every member's verdict on each of 70's three axes, published so the
# mechanism count is DERIVABLE by anyone who rejects a merge, as r7250's pre-registration promised.
# CHOSEN   : does a seat CHOOSE the stand-in at the moment of writing?  (Y = author-chosen,
#            N = moved later by a third party, or by typography, arithmetic or coincidence)
# CONDITION: is it repairable by a better CONDITION?  (Y / N = only by naming, declaring or removing)
# DESTROYS : does it destroy a TRUE VERDICT (Y) or only a DETECTION (N)?
# OBJECT   : what the stand-in stands in FOR.  NOT an axis — recorded because the axes do not
#            name it, and the result below is that this column separates what they cannot.
